# Task8 target runtime and golden provenance

This is a pure rendering contract. All development and verification use WSL Ubuntu; there is no Windows host adaptation or native Windows execution in this task. Goldens pin deterministic target text. Ubuntu execution proves generated POSIX control flow and byte staging, not a real Agama/AutoYaST/Windows/ESXi installation.

## Inputs and stable routes

Existing Request.Firmware is actual boot firmware, mandatory for FileMenu; registered metadata is not its fallback. ESXiBootConfig remains original immutable media input. Artifact roles kernel/initrd/stage2/repo/iso/mboot/esxi-tree keep their Task7 meanings. All fixed answer/aux names come from catalog.DeliveryFileName; Agama now selects autoinst.jsonnet and no aux. All network paths use catalog.AnswerURL/SignalURL/ArtifactURL. Wrappers are scripts/{Seq}.sh or .cmd, raw hook payloads hooks/{Digest} without extension. Gateway serves repository bytes, never a fabricated artifacts/hook route.

New roles: Agama live-root is the actual extracted LiveOS/squashfs.img. Windows requires wimboot, bcd, boot-sdi, boot-wim, winpeshl, winpe-busybox, winpe-curl. They are immutable real inputs. winpeshl must be the real [LaunchApps] ini selecting startnet.cmd; it is injected alongside startup, not generated by a fictitious endpoint. Missing required roles return render_artifact_missing and no bytes; menu requires all seven, aux/script require both tool roles. Renderer trusts layer4's existence, architecture, image/version and ABI attestation, and does no IO to establish it.

Task7 Address/Firmware and original media restrictions remain in menu-aux-contract.md. Existing five Task6 answer/scaffold golden bytes are unchanged.

## Execution and telemetry

Snapshot order is authoritative. Each execution slot reports slot-start, hook-start, hook-report, slot-end. POST uses canonical SignalURL and text/plain; query fields are slot=Seq, timing=Timing, rc=native status, with instance=1-based and digest for hook phases. Slot phases omit hook fields. hook-report body is the final 4096 log bytes. No client sequence counter was added. Layer7 authenticates task/token, checks the frozen slot/instance/digest/timing, associates failures and deduplicates by server identity. Transport failures do not fail installation. Required failures stop with their code; optional failures report and continue. Hash mismatch is65, timeout124, missing target ABI127, failed ESXi process-group probe125, failed ESXi ownership66.

model.EnvName is the only parameter-name mapping and SnapshotValue.EnvValue supplies scalar/list bytes (lists joined by newline). Sorted assignments are shell quoted in base64-staged launcher files; raw hook bodies are never expanded. Ubuntu executes hostile Unicode, apostrophe, double quote, newline, percent, exclamation and shell metacharacter values without wrapper injection. Linux uses a generated sleep watchdog and /proc descendant traversal, not an external timeout executable. Cancelling a watchdog terminates its sleep child; a nonzero sleep status exits the watchdog before it can mark a timeout or kill the completed hook. A deterministic scheduler test executes this cancellation interleaving and preserves optional41 then required-success statuses. ESXi uses setsid plus negative process-group kill. Windows uses maintained busybox-win32 negative PID descendant kill. No fictional machine-side lober executable exists.

## Firstboot and Task9 obligations

Linux: installer stages wrapper and digest payloads outside chroot in the target root, /mnt/sysroot (Kickstart), /target (preseed/Subiquity), /mnt (AutoYaST/Agama). Native systemd runs the local wrappers offline in snapshot order. Each wrapper reads /var/lib/lober/finalize.token; no boot token or hook download is embedded in its firstboot body. Required failure prevents cleanup; success permits init-done/ready and credential deletion. Agama uses post chroot:false and this single service route; no scripts.init dispatch also runs the slots. Task9 supplies target curl/systemd and installer shell/hash/base64 tools. Native service boot/installer integration remains a layer7 machine test. Agama product must come from the actual ISO; do not hardcode Leap for SLES.

Windows: wpeinit precedes startup. Injected tools are copied into X:/lober; wrappers/immutable hook bytes and the exact UTF8-BOM windowsPartScript firstboot.ps1/cleanup.ps1 files are staged beneath X:/lober-oem/$1/ProgramData/lober BEFORE setup /m:X:/lober-oem. Pre wrapper exists at X:/lober/script-Seq.cmd; execute it once through the answer windowsPE RunSynchronous, not also in startnet. Setup copying preserves firstboot data through partitioning. One oobeSystem FirstLogonCommand chain contains firstboot part, every slot, cleanup connected with &&; separate FirstLogonCommands are concurrent. Task9 must provide the login/AutoLogon prerequisite and this one chain within the1024-character native limit.

Windows .cmd contains only2048-character ASCII base64 chunks; free parameters never enter CMD source. -X disables busybox path/env rewriting. A stock CMD launcher records the native full-width %errorlevel% in a local data file. POSIX telemetry reads that value and the outer .cmd returns it, avoiding POSIX exit-width truncation; Setup uses the same capture. Because this native capture bridge uses CMD for both interpreters, all EnvName=value strings must fit8191 UTF16 units, else render_windows_env_limit returns a content Problem (global parameter limits unchanged). Raw PowerShell hook cache bytes are SHA256 checked first; execution receives a temporary BOM copy, with existing BOM kept once. The repository/cache bytes and digest are unchanged. Linux byte tests verify Chinese/non-BMP source with/without BOM; no native PS parser/Windows process behavior was tested here.

winpe-busybox means a build verified against BOTH the chosen PE image and the final installed OS, with UTF8 manifest, -X, sh, base64, sha256sum, head, tail, mktemp, cat, mkdir, rm, sleep and negative PID descendant kill. winpe-curl must be a real compatible binary with its runtime dependencies and HTTP/TLS support in both contexts. Do not assign these roles based only on PE success. The current UTF8-manifest route does not cover Server2016/2019 firstboot; older edition data/static answers are not runtime support evidence. Native CMD/PS, UTF8 environment fidelity, full-width status capture, descendant termination, helper tool availability and OEM/Setup copying are layer7 target validations.

ESXi: one native %firstboot --interpreter=busybox shell envelope with set-e contains firstboot part, all firstboot slots, cleanup. Native installer persists the encoded wrapper, exact hook bytes and independent finalize token; no installer /var/lib persistence or systemd is assumed. At firstboot they materialize in /tmp/lober, verify digest and execute offline. The parent native $0 is exported with task marker lober-esxi-firstboot-TASK. Firstboot/cleanup require an absolute readable regular non-symlink file containing that task's ownership assignment. Invalid/relative/unreadable/mismatched paths fail66, retain credentials and never send ready. Only successful required hooks permit unlink of the owned native section file, then final signals and token/payload removal. Linux tests execute an owned native file, verify its deletion, and prove no/wrong marker, symlink and relative paths are retained. If ESXi supplies supervisor $0, relative $0 or an inaccessible location, the ABI precondition is unsatisfied; layer7 must verify a correct invocation or define an explicit owned path, never guess a vendor directory.

ESXi ABI requires base64/sh/sha256sum/sleep/mktemp/tail/cat/grep/setsid/kill, and wget for transport. Decoder availability is checked before encoded answer execution; wrappers fail before hooks when required tools/process-group control are unavailable. Vendor sources prove busybox/wget and setsid; exact hash/base64/grep/kill applets and behavior on each8/9 image are a declared real-install pending condition, not certified by Linux. Secure Boot suppresses native firstboot: layer7 must reject this lifecycle when Secure Boot is active. UEFI alone is insufficient.

Finalize is a private caller-owned independent24h credential, never an author capability or a fallback to the90min boot credential. Layer7 issues and authorizes it, protects persisted answers, checks timing/retry semantics, and validates all actual target ABI and installer behavior.

## Every new golden line

Menus: menu-sles15.golden line1 is spec/iPXE header; line2 is linuxrc install/profile URLs plus spec serial consoles; line3 matching immutable initrd; line4 iPXE boot. menu-sles16.golden line1/header and lines3–4/initrd/boot have the same sources; line2 follows Agama network and inst.auto docs plus spec console. menu-windows-server.golden: line1/header, line2/wimboot, line3/canonical startup aux, line4/real winpeshl, lines5–6/explicit injected tool ABI, lines7–9/BCD/SDI/WIM, line10/boot follow iPXE, layer4 role contract and the documented native pending restriction. Fixture artifact path names are arbitrary role inputs, not claims about real media extraction.

agama-answer.golden: braces, scripts.pre/post arrays, names, content text blocks, shebang, chroot:false and product field follow Agama scripts/product docs; fragment substitution is spec2.4–2.6. Encoded pre line is the canonical wrapper fetch/execute contract. Encoded post lines stage firstboot slot/hook, install the one native service and stage cleanup per Task6 contract with /mnt target. No native init route is added. It is a renderer scaffold fixture; native Jsonnet evaluation/schema/product/media installation is explicitly pending and Task9 owns the complete builtin profile.

esxi-answer.golden: vmaccepteula, rootpw --iscrypted, install --firstdisk --overwritevmfs, network --bootproto=dhcp, reboot, %pre/%firstboot interpreter headers follow the VMware scripted-install directives. The fixture declares the valid snapshot parameter root_password (word) and substitutes an explicit SHA-512-crypt value, $6$loberfixture$s48HMcReZuTl/hNjsbSzMJwS02PdRGxg.c4S/fcvnK13iqHyU.awFlFtXuNgMr03IcKPWRhuoIqMge0LZ.KGX0. It was generated by openssl passwd -6 -salt loberfixture fixture-only-password and is a public test-only credential. The regression requires that exact encrypted rootpw line and no unexpanded param placeholder. set-e and encoded lines are the Lober runtime/ownership contract above. The native firstboot line includes the real parent $0/ownership marker; its encoded bytes use the approved persisted-section method. No ESXi real-install compatibility is claimed.

startnet.cmd.golden and script-unattend.cmd.golden: every batch prologue/environment/decoder/return line follows the stock CMD bootstrap and limit contract above; every echo chunk is only byte transport for the decoded script. Per-chunk error checks propagate staging failure. The prologue copies actual injected tools and runs wpeinit; the payload stages the local OEM tree, exact owned PS helpers, token, wrappers and raw hooks before Setup. Nested native CMD launchers capture full status; startup never executes firstboot. Decoder and cleanup lines only manipulate task-local temporary files. All native Windows behavior remains pending under the stated ABI.

script-posix.golden: shebang/set-u/umask, protected directory, tool preflight, token/work/trap, signal function, descendant watchdog, canonical hook download, digest guard, base64 parameter launcher, log/tail, required stop and final success lines implement specC11/2.6/5.4 and Task6/runtime contracts above. They are validated by actual Ubuntu busybox/bash syntax and process tests, not installation-media certification. The generated launcher carries model.EnvName/EnvValue; its cache is immutable. Empty status body versus4KiB hook body is intentional.

Tests pin all eight new golden files and the Agama template. Changes after initial generation were limited to observed kill syntax, native ownership, BOM, native-status and watchdog cancellation fixes; each has functional RED/GREEN evidence. Existing Task6/7 goldens were not refreshed.


Final-review corrections (2026-10-13):

- Debian pre/post-installer signals invoke `/usr/bin/wget` from Debian wget-udeb, bypassing standalone BusyBox ash's builtin wget selection. Supported tool contract: GNU wget's `-q -T 10 -O /dev/null --header=Content-Type: text/plain --post-file=FILE`; FILE is a real empty regular file for empty POSTs or the exact final4096 log bytes, including NUL. Post-target/firstboot still use target curl. The real HTTP regression executes frozen hook download/digest/launcher plus all four signals with a restricted applet PATH and no curl in installer cases. Only the qualified absolute wget path and task storage path are relocated; no HTTP client is mocked. The recorded qualification uses the actual Debian trixie wget-udeb1.25.0-2 amd64 executable. Normal test runs use installed GNU wget; `LOBER_DEBIAN_WGET` selects the unpacked udeb. Source/package identities, headers and binary-body evidence live in the final-fix archive. Actual installation-media/tool qualification remains layer4/7.
- ESXi watchdog publishes readiness only after owning its sleep child and TERM trap. Hook and descendants retain their separate setsid process group. Cancellation terminates and waits the sleeper, then the parent waits the watchdog; cancelled wait cannot mark a timeout. Failed readiness publication kills/reaps its sleeper and parent fails125 after stopping/reaping the hook. Tests execute success, quick required/optional failure, sequential hooks, actual timeout/descendants, delayed startup and failed initialization on Ubuntu; no new fractional-sleep or external applet ABI is introduced. ESXi native media qualification remains required.
- Intentionally refreshed `esxi-answer.golden` covers the corrected password fixture and embedded watchdog. The builtin ESXi BIOS/UEFI rendered-answer goldens change only for the embedded renderer watchdog; builtin source models, release archives and fingerprints are unchanged. `meta-data.golden` changes only for I1. Existing archives remain byte-identical.
